title: Saudi Arabian Pineapple Pasta
description: A flavorful and sweet pasta dish inspired by Saudi Arabian cuisine, featuring juicy pineapple and savory spices.

ingredients.name: Saudi
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add mixed spices and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add diced pineapple and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Combine cooked pasta and pineapple mixture in the skillet.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
